channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: O que Milei pode ensinar a Lula sobre economia, afinal
item.description: The article examines what Brazil can learn from Argentina's fiscal adjustment under Javier Milei, noting that despite a severe 27% cut in public spending, Argentina avoided economic collapse and achieved 4.4% GDP growth in 2024. Economist Fabio Giambiagi argues that Brazil requires a much milder adjustment, advocating for capping public spending growth at 4-5% annually instead of current Lula 3 levels, while warning about democratic limits to austerity measures.

item.title: Derrite registra candidatura ao Senado por SP e declara patrimônio 148% maior que em 2022
item.description: Federal deputy Guilherme Derrite (PP) registered his Senate candidacy for São Paulo with the TSE, declaring assets worth R$2.02 million — a 148% increase from 2022. The candidacy was formalized last Friday, March 7. Derrite, former São Paulo Public Security Secretary, aims to expand his political influence at the state level.

item.title: Vice de Flávio: homem que apontou "armação" diz que esteve no 8/1
item.description: Luiz Antonio Lopes, a PL-affiliated merchant, claimed he participated in the January 8, 2023, coup attempt in Brasília but left before arrests after allegedly seeing Gleisi Hoffmann and Lindbergh Farias at the STF, which he interpreted as a 'trap' to frame Alfredo Gaspar (PL-RJ) for rape. He also threatened STF Minister Alexandre de Moraes in a separate video, promising to 'cut off his head' and parade it on a bayonet.

item.title: Haddad chama Tarcísio de “concurseiro” em debate de São Paulo
item.description: During a debate on Bandeirantes TV, Fernando Haddad (PT) criticized Governor Tarcísio de Freitas by calling him a 'concurseiro', implying he relies too heavily on public sector exams for career advancement. The remark contrasts with the Lula government’s policy of encouraging Brazilians to take public exams to expand the state apparatus. Haddad used the term pejoratively, highlighting tensions over the role of public servants in São Paulo’s political discourse.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro escolhe Copacabana para abrir campanha à Presidência
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) will officially launch his presidential campaign on Sunday (August 16) at Copacabana Beach, Rio de Janeiro, alongside allies including Douglas Ruas, Carlos Jordy, and Carlos Portinho. The event underscores the PL’s strategy to mobilize its electoral base in Flávio’s home state, where he built his political career, and takes place at a site that has hosted at least five Bolsonaro-aligned demonstrations since January 2023.

item.title: Lula afasta Sidônio Palmeira do dia a dia da campanha
item.description: President Lula formally removed Sidônio Palmeira, head of the Social Communication Secretariat and architect of his 2022 campaign, from the day-to-day operations of his 2026 re-election bid. Palmeira will continue to serve in his official role at the Palácio do Planalto. The move signals a strategic reorganization of the government’s communication approach ahead of the next election.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro fará primeiro ato de campanha em Copacabana
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has chosen Copacabana Beach in Rio de Janeiro for his first official campaign event in the 2026 presidential race, according to O Globo. The rally will take place next Sunday, the 16th, at a stage historically used by Bolsonaro supporters and previously frequented by his father, former president Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Candidata do PSol erra declaração e informa ter R$ 2 bilhões em bens
item.description: The PSOL candidate for vice-governor of Tocantins, Lúcia Viana, declared to the TSE a patrimony of R$ 2 billion, a figure clearly inflated by typographical errors in asset valuation. Her declared assets include vehicles valued in the millions (such as a Toyota Etios at R$ 35 million, when market value is around R$ 35 thousand) and real estate grossly overvalued (a residential building in Lago Sul declared at R$ 150 million, while local market prices range from R$ 120 thousand to R$ 1 million). To date, the candidate has not publicly commented on the declaration.

item.title: Lula promove exibição de filme sobre Honestino Guimarães no Alvorada
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva hosted a screening of the film 'Honestino', a biopic about student leader and military dictatorship resistor Honestino Guimarães, at the Palácio da Alvorada ahead of its national release. The event is part of the Cine Alvorada series and included officials and guests, though actor Bruno Gagliasso, who portrays the lead, did not attend due to a missed flight.

item.title: Um candidato à Presidência sem bens declarados ao TSE
item.description: Hertz Dias, the PSTU candidate for President, is the first 2026 presidential candidate to declare having no assets in his name to the TSE. So far, besides him, four other candidates have registered and declared assets. President Lula (PT) is also among those who have disclosed their wealth.

item.title: Hugo Motta anuncia apoio a Lula na disputa pela Presidência da República
item.description: Hugo Motta, President of the Chamber of Deputies and a reelection candidate for the Republicans party, declared his support for President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election bid in the 2026 elections. The announcement was made during an interview in Paraíba, following the national party's decision to grant neutrality, allowing state directories and members to support candidates based on regional judgment. Motta stated his support aligns with Lula's national project, which he believes is best for the country.

item.title: Governador do Amazonas se reúne com Lula para discutir efeitos do El Niño
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) met on Monday afternoon, the 10th, with Amazonas Governor Roberto Cidade (União) at the Palácio da Alvorada. During the meeting, the governor requested federal support to address the climatic effects of El Niño in the state.

item.title: Candidato do PSTU é o 1º presidenciável sem bens declarados ao TSE
item.description: Hertz Dias, the PSTU's pre-candidate for president, is the first 2026 presidential candidate to declare no assets to the TSE. So far, five candidates have registered their candidacies, with Dias being the only one without declared assets. Romeu Zema (Novo) leads in declared wealth at R$ 170 million.

item.title: R$ 1 mil para recém-nascidos, reforma no Bolsa Família e flexibilização da CLT: os detalhes do plano de governo de Zema
item.description: Romeu Zema proposes an 'implacable' government plan featuring a R$1,000 investment for every newborn, invested in stock funds accessible at age 18 to promote financial literacy and wealth-building; full privatization of all state-owned enterprises to reduce corruption and increase efficiency; a pension reform that would include military and rural workers with automatic retirement age adjustments based on life expectancy; and reforms to Bolsa Família aimed at discouraging long-term dependency by requiring able-bodied beneficiaries to remain engaged in the labor market.

item.title: Flávio escolhe Praia de Copacabana para estreia da campanha e resgata modelo de atos de Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro chose Copacabana Beach for the official launch of his 2026 presidential campaign, holding an outdoor rally modeled after his father Jair Bolsonaro’s past demonstrations. The choice symbolizes an attempt to replicate the bolsonarist mobilization model and test his ability to draw the political base built by his father into the streets. Organized by the Rio PL leadership, the event marks the campaign’s initial focus on the Southeast and reinforces the symbolic father-son linkage in the electoral race.

item.title: Cargos em disputa e dia da eleição são as principais buscas de brasileiros no Google; veja lista
item.description: Less than a week before the official start of campaigns for the 2026 Brazilian elections, Google searches related to the elections have significantly increased, with the main focus being on offices up for election and election date. The research indicates that Brazilians are preparing to participate in the electoral process, seeking basic information about how and when to vote.

item.title: “Qual o Pix do senhor?”, brinca empresário com Caiado em almoço em SP
item.description: At a lunch in São Paulo, businessman Ricardo Battistini joked with presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado about donations, asking 'What is your Pix?' and suggesting Caiado would leave with 1 million reais. Caiado is raising funds exclusively through a 'virtual piggy bank', as other donation methods are only allowed after candidacy registration on August 15, per TSE rules. The event featured business leaders and Alexandre Baldy, BYD Brazil’s vice president, who detailed the legal contribution process.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro cobra apoio a Carlos em SC e pede que presidente do PL Mulher no estado 'não use' sua imagem ou do pai
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro publicly urged state deputy Ana Campagnolo (PL-SC) to support his brother Carlos Bolsonaro’s Senate campaign in Santa Catarina, threatening to withdraw permission to use his and Jair Bolsonaro’s image if she did not comply. Campagnolo replied that she would continue working to fulfill the PL’s objectives in SC, avoiding a direct endorsement. The move has caused internal party tensions, disrupting a planned alliance with the PP and prompting resistance from local leaders over Carlos Bolsonaro’s candidacy.

item.title: “Terremoto na Colômbia” deixa 111 mortos e 87 feridos, diz presidente
item.description: A 7.4 magnitude earthquake struck Colombia's Chocó region on Monday morning, killing 111 and injuring 87, according to President Abelardo De La Espriella. The disaster damaged 1,575 homes, destroyed 37, collapsed 61 buildings, and affected health centers, schools, roads, and airports. The president declared a public calamity, activated emergency command, and received international solidarity from figures including Ursula von der Leyen, Lula, and Marco Rubio.

item.title: Hugo Motta retribui gesto do presidente e diz que apoiará candidatura de Lula à reeleição
item.description: Hugo Motta, President of the Chamber of Deputies (Republicanos-PB), announced his support for President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s re-election bid in 2026, aligning with the positioning of the Republicanos party’s Paraíba state directory. He stated that Lula aligns with the party’s vision of what is best for the country. Motta also revealed that Lula has committed to supporting his re-election as Chamber President in 2027, an agreement brokered by Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI).

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Lula tira Sidônio da coordenação da campanha que busca a reeleição
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has removed Sidônio Palmeira from the coordination of his 2026 re-election campaign. Despite being regarded as one of the most influential ministers in the government, Sidônio has been facing internal political wear and tear. The decision was reported on the 'Papo Antagonista' program and echoed by O Antagonista.

item.title: Homem que relatou "armação" contra vice de Flávio é filiado ao PL
item.description: Luis Antonio Lopes, a Rio de Janeiro merchant who alleged a 'setup' against Flávio Bolsonaro's vice-presidential pick Alfredo Gaspar (PL), is a PL member since April 30, 2026 — one week after giving testimony to the Legislative Police. He claimed the plot involved recruiting Marcela Maria Mendes to falsely pose as a rape victim. The testimony was forwarded to the STF after Lopes accused individuals tied to PT deputy Lindbergh Farias of orchestrating the scheme.

item.title: Campanha vê 'vitória' de Haddad no início do debate, mas lamenta falas técnicas; aliados de Tarcísio mostram alívio: 'salvaram-se todos'
item.description: Both Haddad's and Tarcísio's campaigns viewed their candidates' performances positively in the first Band debate, though Haddad's team criticized excessive time spent on technical topics like state debt and budget, while praising the initial focus on public security. Tarcísio's campaign expressed relief with the phrase 'everyone was saved,' noting the governor successfully addressed tough issues like security, economy, and education without damaging his lead in polls, where he holds 48% to Haddad's 32% in a potential runoff.

item.title: Mudanças podem reduzir desconfiança no STF, dizem especialistas em seminário da Folha
item.description: Experts at a Folha seminar stated that adopting conduct rules for Supreme Court justices could reduce public distrust in the institution and strengthen its legitimacy. Such changes would help ensure the STF exercises its constitutional powers with greater credibility. The measure is seen as a step toward reinforcing institutional trust in the Judiciary.

item.title: Setor de petróleo faz alerta ao governo Lula sobre risco de apagão de combustíveis no Norte
item.description: The oil sector warned the Lula government about the risk of a fuel shortage in northern Brazil due to prolonged drought, low navigability of the Tapajós River, and lack of maintenance, threatening supply for 7.5 million people. The Brazilian Institute of Petroleum and Gas (IBP) cited the El Niño phenomenon and the veto on private investments of R$50 million for dredging at seven critical points as aggravating factors, urging emergency actions to prevent widespread fuel shortages by September.

item.title: Governo Lula promete agregar valor às terras raras para que país não seja apenas exportador de minerais
item.description: The Lula government announced a plan to add value to rare earths and critical minerals, aiming to reduce import dependence and turn Brazil into a processor, not just an exporter of raw materials. The initiative seeks to strengthen national technological and industrial sovereignty through specific policies for these strategic resources.

item.title: Casado: Candidatura de Cleitinho oferece palanque duplo para Flávio em MG
item.description: Cleitinho's candidacy for governor of Minas Gerais opens the possibility of a 'double palanque' for Flávio Bolsonaro in the state, according to columnist Letícia Casado on UOL News. This articulation suggests coordinated support between the two figures to strengthen the Bolsonarist base in Minas Gerais for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Patrimônio de Carol de Toni dobra em 4 anos e atinge R$ 1,4 milhão
item.description: Federal deputy Carol de Toni (PL-SC) doubled her wealth between 2022 and 2026, increasing from R$ 651,000 to R$ 1.4 million, according to her TSE asset declaration. The growth stems mainly from real estate, financial investments, and capital advance in Zancanaro Viva Park LTDA. She is a Senate candidate for Santa Catarina in 2026, confirmed at the party convention on August 1st.

item.title: Haddad quer câmeras corporais de policiais com gravação contínua em SP
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT), candidate for governor of São Paulo, unveiled the 'SP Protege' public security plan, proposing continuous recording body cameras for police, WhatsApp-based police reports, and measures against gender, racial, and child violence. The plan includes creating a permanent State Anti-Corruption Agency, structured police career development, a dedicated task force at Santos Port, and AI-driven crime prediction tools. Haddad criticized the current Tarcísio de Freitas administration during the launch.

item.title: O diagnóstico que Damares fez sobre os presidenciáveis em encontro com Unicef
item.description: Senator Damares Alves criticized presidential candidates for focusing heavily on women's issues while neglecting childhood-focused proposals in their campaigns, despite acknowledging progress on gender-related topics as positive. She attributed this omission to the fact that children do not vote, making the issue less strategically relevant to candidates. The assessment was made during a meeting with Unicef Brazil representative Joaquín González-Aleman.

item.title: Com militares fora do jogo eleitoral, Lula evita ‘vespeiros’ e prioriza reequipamento
item.description: Lula's government prioritizes reequipping and technological autonomy of the Armed Forces in its 2026 program, avoiding institutional confrontation after January 8th and investigations into a coup plot involving military officers. The strategy seeks to depoliticize relations with the barracks, focusing on technical and industrial agendas, while U.S. geopolitics under Trump raises concerns about sovereignty and external influence.

item.title: Diretor-geral da PF tira férias em meio à crise com André Mendonça
item.description: The director-general of the Federal Police, Andrei Rodrigues, took a pre-scheduled week of vacation amid a crisis with Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, who demands access to raw investigative documents from the 'INSS Party' case and authority to approve changes in the investigative team involving Lulinha, President Lula’s son. The PF argues the order undermines police autonomy, while the AGU and Justice Minister attempt mediation without success.

item.title: UNE convoca protesto contra ato de Renan Santos na USP
item.description: The UNE and the XI de Agosto Academic Center at USP called for a protest against the first campaign event of Renan Santos, a candidate for the presidency of the Mission, taking place at Largo São Francisco. The demonstration opposes the event, as Renan studied at the institution and aims to gather over 2,000 attendees.

item.title: Quaest: 31% dos eleitores priorizam candidatos ao Senado com foco em emendas e obras para o estado
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows that 31% of voters prioritize candidates for the Senate who focus on bringing amendments and public works to their state in the 2026 elections. Next, 15% favor candidates endorsed by President Lula, 13% prioritize ending the 6x1 work schedule, 12% value independence from political polarization, and 11% support impeaching STF ministers. Bolsonaro’s endorsement attracts 8%, while 10% were unsure or gave no response. The survey interviewed 2,004 people aged 16+ from July 31 to August 3, with a 2-point margin of error at 95% confidence.

item.title: Plano de segurança de Haddad prevê agência estadual antifacção em SP
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) launched the SP Protege security plan, proposing the creation of a State Anti-Faction Agency to combat organized crime through asset seizures, disruption of criminal mechanisms in the formal economy, and social allocation of confiscated goods. The plan also includes a quarterly Security Scorecard tracking crime resolution rates and the option to file police reports via WhatsApp. Haddad criticized Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, claiming he lacks the structure to fight organized crime and is paving the way for militias in São Paulo.

item.title: A reaproximação de Paes e Rueda após União Brasil abandonar aliança com o PL no Rio
item.description: Antonio Rueda, president of União Brasil, appeared at an event with former mayor Eduardo Paes in São João de Meriti, just days after the party ended its alliance with the PL in Rio de Janeiro. The União Progressista federation maintained neutrality in the state race, withdrawing support from PL candidate Douglas Ruas, thereby strengthening Paes’ campaign, which leads in polls. The shift reflects Paes’ efforts to broaden his base, aided by PP Rio president Dr. Luizinho.

item.title: Caiado cita Armínio Fraga como principal referência para a economia
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) stated that economist Armínio Fraga is his main reference in economic policy, though he did not confirm Fraga for the Finance Ministry. He also mentioned economist Ana Carla Abrão as part of government discussions and emphasized his goal of surrounding himself with the best experts.

item.title: Caiado critica a possibilidade de Lula e Flávio evitarem debates no início do período eleitoral
item.description: Former Goiás governor and presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized the possibility of Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) avoiding the first electoral debates, calling it 'moral cowardice' and a sign they cannot explain allegations against themselves and allies. He emphasized the importance of the female vote, citing his record of appointing women to leadership roles in Goiás, and called for stricter penalties for feminicide. Caiado also attacked PT social policies like Bolsa Família, claiming they discourage work, and identified insecurity, organized crime, household debt, and inadequate education as Brazil’s gravest challenges.

item.title: Caiado cita deputado Pedro Paulo e Ana Carla Abrão entre opções para a área administrativa
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD candidate for President of Brazil, mentioned Deputy Pedro Paulo (PSD) and Ana Carla Abrão as possible names for the administrative area of his government plan. The statement was made during the Diálogos CEO One event, promoted by VIP Battistini, a corporate networking ecosystem. Caiado emphasized the importance of selecting qualified professionals for public management.

item.title: Renan Santos desafia Flávio Bolsonaro e propõe acordo na campanha
item.description: Renan Santos challenged Flávio Bolsonaro to participate in electoral debates and criticized the PL candidate's lack of policy proposals, suggesting an agreement to prevent the leakage of compromising videos involving Bolsonaro. He emphasized the opponent's unserious campaign and reinforced his own commitment to transparency.

item.title: Reinaldo Azevedo – 10/08/26: Haddad e Tarcísio: 1º debate de 2030?; lágrimas eleitoreiras de Flávio
item.description: Columnist Reinaldo Azevedo comments on the possibility of a first debate between Fernando Haddad and Tarcísio de Freitas for the 2030 elections, suggesting an early political showdown. He also criticizes Flávio Bolsonaro's 'electoral tears,' indicating such displays are strategically used for electoral gain. The content includes YouTube video clips related to these discussions.

item.title: Republicanos neutro, Motta com Lula na Paraíba
item.description: Hugo Motta, president of the Chamber of Deputies and member of the Republicans party from Paraíba, declared his support for President Lula's re-election in Paraíba, despite the national party's neutrality. His stance reflects a local alliance between the Republicans and the PT in the state, diverging from the party's national directive.

item.title: Crusoé: O problema de ACM Neto com o bolsonarismo
item.description: ACM Neto, the União Brasil candidate for governor of Bahia, avoids associating with Bolsonarism and affirms his support for Ronaldo Caiado's presidential pre-candidacy. He seeks to distance himself from former President Jair Bolsonaro while maintaining a political stance aligned with center-right figures. The content highlights Neto's challenge in balancing right-wing support without directly aligning with Bolsonarism.

item.title: Silveira vê ‘maioria’ do PSD com Lula no 2º turno e diz que presidente é fonte de estabilidade
item.description: Minister Alexandre Silveira (PSD) states that the majority of his party will support Lula in a potential second-round runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro, citing PSD mayors who already back Lula in the first round. He views Lula as a source of institutional stability and warns that a Flávio Bolsonaro victory could bring institutional instability, particularly amid current global tensions.

item.title: Em encontro com empresários, Caiado chama Lula e Flávio de covardes
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) harshly criticized President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) during a meeting with business leaders in São Paulo, calling them "cowards" and accusing them of "moral cowardice" for avoiding electoral debates. He also advocated for public security proposals, including reducing the age of criminal responsibility to 16 for specific crimes and classifying criminal factions as domestic terrorist organizations, while naming prosecutor Lincoln Gakiya as a potential future Minister of Public Security.

item.title: Vice de Flávio: Câmara envia depoimento de ‘homem-bomba’ ao STF
item.description: The presidency of the Chamber of Deputies has sent the full testimony of merchant Luiz Antonio Lopes, known as the 'human bomb', to the Supreme Federal Court (STF). Lopes alleged a plot to fabricate a rape accusation against deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL), who is the running mate of Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 election. He claimed he was coerced into participating in the scheme. The case is politically significant as it involves the Bolsonaro ticket in an alleged disinformation and defamation operation ahead of the elections.

item.title: Debate da Band entre Tarcísio e Haddad perde para João Kleber
item.description: The Band debate between Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad recorded low viewership in Greater São Paulo, with only 1.5 rating points and a peak of 2 points, falling even below João Kleber's show. The result suggests public disengagement or low perceived relevance of the electoral debate.

item.title: Motta registra candidatura e declara R$ 1,3 milhão em bens
item.description: Hugo Motta, president of the Chamber of Deputies, filed his candidacy for the 2026 elections and declared R$ 1.26 million in assets to the TSE, representing an 8.1% increase from 2022. Declared assets include R$ 250,000 in cash, a 50% stake in an aircraft (R$ 100,000), capital quotas (R$ 100,000), properties in Brasília, João Pessoa, and Patos, a vehicle, and bank balances. The asset disclosure is a mandatory part of candidate registration and is publicly accessible via the TSE.

item.title: Hugo Motta declara apoio à reeleição de Lula: 'O melhor para o país'
item.description: Hugo Motta, President of the Chamber of Deputies, announced that the Republican Party's Paraíba state directory will support Lula's re-election in 2026, following the party's national leadership decision to remain neutral and allow state directories to choose their own candidates. The statement was made during the swearing-in of Judge Giovanna Mayer at the TRE-PB, with Motta stating the support is based on alignment with what he believes is best for the country. The move also reflects Motta's political strategy to back his father, Nabor Wanderley, for Senate in 2026, strengthening an alliance with the federal government.

item.title: O que dizem as últimas pesquisas para presidente nas Eleições 2026
item.description: Four recent polls show Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) as the leading candidates in the 2026 Brazilian presidential race, with varying percentages depending on the pollster and runoff scenario. Lula holds a slight edge in some surveys, while Bolsonaro leads in others, indicating a highly competitive and polarized contest. The results suggest the runoff will likely be decided between these two figures, with no other candidates currently demonstrating significant relevance.
